lines.text: قال اوّل ما رسَمْتُ
lines.plain: قال اوّل ما رسَمْتُ

lines.text: دائرة الفلك الممثَّل عليها
lines.plain: دائرة الفلك الممثَّل عليها

lines.text: {ov:ا ب ج د} مركز على {ov:ه} ودائرة
lines.plain: ا ب ج د مركز على ه ودائرة

lines.text: *أُخْرَى للفلك المائل{n:1} عليها{mR:f. 65,v.}
lines.plain: *أُخْرَى للفلك المائل عليها

lines.text: {ov:ح ب ز د} مركزها ايضًا نقطة{mL:5}
lines.plain: ح ب ز د مركزها ايضًا نقطة

lines.text: {ov:ه} كما تقع في الكُرِيّ ودائرة
lines.plain: ه كما تقع في الكُرِيّ ودائرة

lines.text: ثالثة للفلك الخارج عليها
lines.plain: ثالثة للفلك الخارج عليها

lines.text: {ov:ح ط ك ل} وعلى مركزها {ov:م}
lines.plain: ح ط ك ل وعلى مركزها م

lines.text: فبَيِّنٌ أنّ نقطة {ov:ح} هي
lines.plain: فبَيِّنٌ أنّ نقطة ح هي

lines.text: البعد الابعد ونقطة {ov:ك} البعد{mL:10}
lines.plain: البعد الابعد ونقطة ك البعد

lines.text: الاقرب من الفلك الخارج المركز ونجعَل نقطة {ov:ط} من الفلك الخارج مركزًا لدائرة فلك التدوير ونُدير
lines.plain: الاقرب من الفلك الخارج المركز ونجعَل نقطة ط من الفلك الخارج مركزًا لدائرة فلك التدوير ونُدير

lines.text: عليها دائرة فلك التدوير عليها {ov:ف ق س} ونُخْرِج منه{n:2} خطّ {ov:م ط ق} وخطّ {ov:ه ط ف} ونفرِض مَوْضِع الكوكب
lines.plain: عليها دائرة فلك التدوير عليها ف ق س ونُخْرِج منه خطّ م ط ق وخطّ ه ط ف ونفرِض مَوْضِع الكوكب

lines.text: من فلك التدوير نقطة {ov:ع} ونُخْرِج خطّ {ov:ه ع ن}{n:3} الذي تُرَى عليه حركة الكوكب في فلك البروج
lines.plain: من فلك التدوير نقطة ع ونُخْرِج خطّ ه ع ن الذي تُرَى عليه حركة الكوكب في فلك البروج

lines.text: وبيّن انَّ قطر {ov:ا ز} يجوز على المراكز وايضًا نتّخِذ نقطة {ov:ل} من الفلك الخارج مركزًا ونُدير عليه
lines.plain: وبيّن انَّ قطر ا ز يجوز على المراكز وايضًا نتّخِذ نقطة ل من الفلك الخارج مركزًا ونُدير عليه

lines.text: دائرة لفلك التدوير عليها {ov:ي لا س}{n:4} ونُخْرِج خطَّيْ {ov:م ل ي} و{ov:ه ل لا} ونَجْعَل الكوكب في موضع {ov:س} من{mL:15}
lines.plain: دائرة لفلك التدوير عليها ي لا س ونُخْرِج خطَّيْ م ل ي وه ل لا ونَجْعَل الكوكب في موضع س من

lines.text: فلك التدوير ونُخْرِج خطّ {ov:ه ش ض} الذي يُرَى عليه في فلك البروج فبَيِّنٌ هو في هذه الدَّوَايِر انّه
lines.plain: فلك التدوير ونُخْرِج خطّ ه ش ض الذي يُرَى عليه في فلك البروج فبَيِّنٌ هو في هذه الدَّوَايِر انّه

lines.text: اذا كانت نقطة {ov:ا} سَمْت البعد الابعد في فلك البروج وكان الكوكب في نقطة {ov:ع} من فلك التدوير
lines.plain: اذا كانت نقطة ا سَمْت البعد الابعد في فلك البروج وكان الكوكب في نقطة ع من فلك التدوير

lines.text: الذي مركزه {ov:ط} وكان مركز فلك التدوير في نقطة {ov:ح} إِنّ الخطّ الذي يخرُج من نقطة {ov:ه} يجوز على
lines.plain: الذي مركزه ط وكان مركز فلك التدوير في نقطة ح إِنّ الخطّ الذي يخرُج من نقطة ه يجوز على

lines.text: مركز {ov:م} ونقطة {ov:ا} و{ov:ح} ونَجِد نقطة البعد الابعد في فلك التدوير على علامة {ov:ق} التي في{n:5} خطّ
lines.plain: مركز م ونقطة ا وح ونَجِد نقطة البعد الابعد في فلك التدوير على علامة ق التي في خطّ

lines.text: {ov:م ط ق} وذلك أنّ خطّ {ov:م ط ق} عند ذلك يكون موضع خطّ {ov:ه م ا} ويكون موضع {ov:ق} حينئذٍ موضع {ov:ا}{mL:20}
lines.plain: م ط ق وذلك أنّ خطّ م ط ق عند ذلك يكون موضع خطّ ه م ا ويكون موضع ق حينئذٍ موضع ا

lines.text: فيكون البعد الابعد الاوسط والحقيقيّ سَوَاءً بِلَا اختلاف لأنّ خطّ {ov:ه ط ف} الذي عليه تُرَى نقطة
lines.plain: فيكون البعد الابعد الاوسط والحقيقيّ سَوَاءً بِلَا اختلاف لأنّ خطّ ه ط ف الذي عليه تُرَى نقطة

lines.text: البعد الابعد الحقيقيّة حينئذٍ يصير موضع خطّ {ov:ه ا} *ايضًا ولكن اذا صار مركز فلك التدوير في موضع{mR:f. 66,r.}
lines.plain: البعد الابعد الحقيقيّة حينئذٍ يصير موضع خطّ ه ا *ايضًا ولكن اذا صار مركز فلك التدوير في موضع

notes.text: 1) Deest in cod. — 2) Cod. من — 3) Pro ع cod. ف — 4) Cod. ي لا ع — 5) Cod. الذي قد

observations: L01, L02, L04, L07, L08, L09: long joins (مـا, الممثَّـل, عليهـا three times, ثالثـة, مركزهـا, نقطـة) are not transcribed; nor the long kāf of the words that have it (المراكز on L14).

The page continues chapter 31; it has no heading and no printer's signature. The figure stands at the upper left, and the first ten lines of the text are set beside it in a narrow column at the right (384 to 500 pt); L01 begins the paragraph, set in from the right (it begins at 476 pt). Lines 11 to 22 run the full measure (76 to 500 pt) under the figure. The folio numbers «f. 65,v.» and «f. 66,r.» stand in the right margin beside L04 and L22: the asterisk of the first stands at the head of L04, before أُخْرَى, that of the second on L22 before ايضًا. Nallino's line numbers 5, 10, 15 and 20 stand in the left margin, the first two beside the figure. The notes stand in one line, set in, 27 pt under the rule.

Figure F01 (redrawn; its measures and the way they were taken are in the geometry). Two great circles of one size (radius 99.4 and 99.3 pt), the first about the point م and the second about the point ه, 15.0 pt under it on the upright axis, cross at the left and at the right; a third circle (radius 81.5 pt) stands within them about م. The axis runs from the top of the first circle to the foot of the second: ا stands over its top end, outside the circles, ح under the top of the second circle at the left of the axis, م at the left of the axis over its point, the small round ه under its point, ك over the foot of the third circle, ج over the foot of the first and ز under the foot of the second, outside. A small circle (radius 39.3 pt) stands at the left about the crossing of the great circles, by ب, and one (radius 38.3 pt) at the right about the crossing by د. At the left five lines meet in the point by ط, on the third circle, 20.8 pt from the centre of the small circle: from ف and from ق on the small circle, from ع at its foot, from م and from ه; a long line runs from ن through ع to ه; ص stands under ب and س under ط. At the right the line from م ends on the third circle at ل, the line from ه passes through ل and ends in the centre of the small circle, by د, and from there lines run to لا and to ي on the small circle; a line runs from ه past ش to ض; a short line runs from ل down beside the third circle (at most 1.8 pt within its arc) and ends on it above ش; و stands over ل.

Figure F01, its 22 letters in the order of the file: on the axis from the top ا, ح, م, ه, ك, ج, ز; at the left ف, ب, ص, ط, س, ق, ع, ن; at the right لا (the ligature of lām and alif), و, ل, د, ي, ش, ض. The text of the page names the circles ا ب ج د, ح ب ز د and ح ط ك ل and the epicycles ف ق س about ط and ي لا س about ل; the figure has its small circles about the crossings by ب and د, not about ط and ل, and two letters, ص and و, that this page does not name.

The letters of the figure in the text are overlined, each group under its own bar (11.8 to 34.2 pt): {ov:ا ب ج د} and {ov:ه} (L03), {ov:ح ب ز د} (L05), {ov:ه} (L06), {ov:ح ط ك ل} and {ov:م} (L08), {ov:ح} (L09), {ov:ك} (L10), {ov:ط} (L11), {ov:ف ق س}, {ov:م ط ق} and {ov:ه ط ف} (L12), {ov:ع} and {ov:ه ع ن} (L13), {ov:ا ز} and {ov:ل} (L14), {ov:ي لا س}, {ov:م ل ي}, {ov:ه ل لا} and {ov:س} (L15), {ov:ه ش ض} (L16), {ov:ا} and {ov:ع} (L17), {ov:ط}, {ov:ح} and {ov:ه} (L18), {ov:م}, {ov:ا}, {ov:ح} and {ov:ق} (L19), {ov:م ط ق} twice, {ov:ه م ا}, {ov:ق} and {ov:ا} (L20), {ov:ه ط ف} (L21) and {ov:ه ا} (L22). The ه of these groups is the small round form (2.6-2.8 x 3.2-3.4 pt); لا is the ligature of lām and alif. The order of the letters of each group is that of the ink under its bar, from right to left (scratch barunder.py). The page has no numerals in letters.
Final yā': with its two dots in في, الذي, التي, هي (L09), الكُرِيّ (L06), خطَّيْ (L15), والحقيقيّ (L21); without dots in على, وعلى, الى, أُخْرَى (L04), تُرَى (L13, L21) and يُرَى (L16).

L01: اوّل, خطّ, وخطّ, الخطّ, وبيّن, نتّخِذ, انّه, والحقيقيّ, الحقيقيّة: a shadda. رسَمْتُ: a fatha over the sīn, a round sukun over the mīm and a damma over the tā'; no sign over the rā' (both copies; p. 94 has رَسَمْنا with two fathas). The automatic line finding missed this line, so that it has no machine reading to compare; it is read from the 600-dpi strip, the enlargements and the second copy.
L02: دائرة, ودائرة, لدائرة, المائل (L04) and حينئذٍ (L20, L22): the hamza over its tooth. الممثَّل: over the thā', above its three dots, a shadda with a fatha above it (two marks).
L04: أُخْرَى: over the alif the hamza with a damma above it in one cluster (3.2 x 6.1 pt), a round sukun over the khā', beside its dot, and a fatha over the rā'. The reference to note 1 after المائل.
L05: ايضًا (L05, L22), مركزًا (L11, L14): fathatan; وايضًا (L14) has none.

L06: الكُرِيّ: a damma over the kāf, a kasra under the rā' and a shadda over the yā'. Over the hamza of ودائرة a small dot (1.4 x 1.8 pt, 10.5 to 12.3 pt over the baseline) stands in both copies; it has the form of no sign and is not transcribed.
L07: الخارج (L07, L11 twice, L14) and الخطّ (L18): the dot of the khā' stands inside the ligature of the lām and the khā', joined to it in the master scan and free in the second copy.

L09: فبَيِّنٌ: a fatha over the bā', a shadda over the yā' and over the nūn the dammatan (4.3 x 5.0 pt); under the two dots of the yā' a short mark (1.4 x 1.4 pt), in both copies: the kasra, printed short (it is whole on L16, 3.2 x 2.2 pt). أنّ (L09, L20): the bare hamza over the alif and a shadda over the nūn; انَّ (L14): over the nūn a shadda with a fatha above it (two marks), no hamza; لأنّ (L21): the bare hamza over the lām-alif and a shadda over the nūn.
L11: ونجعَل: a fatha over the ʿayn; ونَجْعَل (L15): a fatha over the nūn, a round sukun over the jīm and a fatha over the ʿayn. ونُدير (L11, L14): a damma over the nūn.

L12: ونُخْرِج (L12, L13, L15, L16): a damma over the nūn, a round sukun over the khā', above its dot, and a kasra under the rā'. The reference to note 2 after منه. ونفرِض: a kasra under the rā'. مَوْضِع: a fatha over the mīm, a round sukun over the wāw and a kasra under the ḍād; موضع (L15, L20 three times, L22 twice): no signs.
L13: the reference to note 3 after {ov:ه ع ن}. تُرَى (L13, L21): a damma over the tā' and a fatha over the rā'; يُرَى (L16): a damma over the yā' and a fatha over the rā'.
L14: نتّخِذ: a shadda over the tā' and a kasra under the khā'.
L15: the reference to note 4 after {ov:ي لا س}. خطَّيْ: on the upright of the ṭā' a shadda with a fatha above it and a round sukun over the yā'.
L16: فبَيِّنٌ: as on L09, with the kasra whole. الدَّوَايِر: over the dāl a shadda with a fatha above it (two marks), a fatha over the wāw and a kasra under the yā'.
L17: سَمْت: a fatha over the sīn and a round sukun over the mīm.
L18: إِنّ: the hamza and its kasra in one sort under the alif and a shadda over the nūn. يخرُج: a damma over the rā'.
L19: ونَجِد: a fatha over the nūn and a kasra under the jīm. The reference to note 5 after في.
L20: حينئذٍ (L20, L22): under the dhāl the kasratan.

L21: سَوَاءً: a fatha over the sīn, a fatha over the wāw and, after the alif, the hamza on the line with the fathatan above it in one cluster (4.0 x 5.8 pt). بِلَا: a kasra under the bā' and a fatha over the lām-alif.

Notes: one line, set in (it begins at 104 pt): «1) Deest in cod. — 2) Cod. من — 3) Pro ع cod. ف — 4) Cod. ي لا ع — 5) Cod. الذي قد» (the Arabic words and letters in the small type; read at 900 dpi). In note 4 the yā' stands at the right, then لا, then ع.

figures.name: F01
figures.note: the figure of chapter 31 for the spheres of a planet, as the edition prints it (note 1 of p. 95: «Figuram damus quam codex ineptissime praebet»): two great circles of the same size, one about the point م (radius 99.4 pt), with ا above its top and ج at its foot, and one about the point ه, 15.0 pt lower (radius 99.3 pt), with ح under its top and ز under its foot; they cross at the left by ب and at the right by د; a third circle about م (radius 81.5 pt) with ك at its foot; a small circle at the left (radius 39.3 pt, its centre 20.8 pt from the point ط where the lines meet) and one at the right (radius 38.3 pt, its centre 0.7 pt from the point by د where the lines meet); the upright axis from the top of the first circle to the foot of the second; from the meeting point by ط five lines, to ف, ق and ع on the left circle, to م and to ه; a line from ن through ع to ه; from م a line to the point ل on the third circle; from ه a line through ل to the meeting point by د, and from there lines to لا and ي on the right circle; a line from ه past ش to ض; and a short line from ل down beside the third circle, a chord of it (at most 1.8 pt from its arc, so that the two strokes print as one band), which ends where it meets the circle again above ش. Measured on the master scan at 1200 dpi (scratch fig/figfit.py, fig/m1056_a.py to _c.py): the five circles and the thirteen lines are least-squares fits to the middle of their strokes where no other ink runs into them (rms 0.04 to 0.11 pt), with their measured widths; the meeting points are the points nearest to the lines that run to each (the lines pass within 0.4 pt of them); a line ends at its meeting point, at the fitted circle it runs to, or where its ink ends (ن, ض); the short line is fitted on its free middle part and drawn from the foot of the point ل on it (0.8 pt from that point). The 22 letters are set at the centres of their printed ink, measured after the fitted strokes were taken out of the image; the letter ه by the centre is the small round form
